theorem.name: matrix_prs_iff_CTX_S_NOR_S

theorem.name: identityRel_CTX_S_eq_NOR_S

theorem.name: InvariantBasis.inv_eq_of_off_support
theorem.description: A change that touches no supported field preserves the invariant.

theorem.name: EffectModel.hasVerdict_exists
theorem.description: Every transformation family has a verdict relative to an invariant basis.

theorem.name: EffectModel.hasVerdict_unique
theorem.description: Verdicts are mutually exclusive: a family has at most one verdict relative to a basis.

theorem.name: EffectModel.noneBreak_of_writes_off_support
theorem.description: A family that may write no supported field never changes the invariant.

theorem.name: EffectModel.stepIdentity_sound
theorem.description: The invariant is constant on classes of the step-generated identity relation.

theorem.name: EffectModel.collapse_iff_stepAgree
theorem.description: Two bases generate the same identity relation on a domain exactly when they agree on every step in the domain.

theorem.name: EffectModel.separation_of_step
theorem.description: A step that one basis preserves and the other changes relates its endpoints under the first basis and not under the second.

theorem.name: EffectModel.not_collapse_mono
theorem.description: If two bases do not collapse on a domain, they do not collapse on any larger domain.

theorem.name: EffectModel.collapse_of_no_step
theorem.description: Two bases collapse on a domain that contains no admissible step.

theorem.name: EffectModel.exists_instance_of_split
theorem.description: If a family never changes one basis invariant but sometimes changes another, some effective instance is preserved by the first and changed by the second.

theorem.name: EffectModel.not_collapse_of_split
theorem.description: A domain containing an effective instance preserved by one basis and changed by the other separates the two bases.

theorem.name: EffectModel.identityRel_le_stepIdentity
theorem.description: The family-level identity relation is contained in the step-level identity relation.

theorem.name: EffectModel.stepIdentity_eq_identityRel_of_uniform
theorem.description: When every family either preserves all its steps or changes all of them, the step-level and family-level identity relations coincide.

theorem.name: Scope.strict_extension_prs
theorem.description: With a single organization field, strict AD has verdict prs for the extension basis.

theorem.name: Scope.strict_structure_brk
theorem.description: Strict AD has verdict brk for the structure basis.

theorem.name: Scope.loose_extension_mix
theorem.description: If AD may change coverage, it has verdict mix for the extension basis.

theorem.name: Scope.loose_structure_brk
theorem.description: Loose AD has verdict brk for the structure basis.

theorem.name: Scope.strict_separates
theorem.description: A domain containing the strict AD step from one provision to two separates the extension and structure bases.

theorem.name: Scope.strict_collapses_on_single
theorem.description: On a domain with no restructuring step the extension and structure bases collapse, although the verdicts of AD differ.

theorem.name: Rule.strict_content_prs
theorem.description: Strict RF, which keeps coverage and every norm, has verdict prs for the content basis.

theorem.name: Rule.strict_structure_brk
theorem.description: Strict RF has verdict brk for the structure basis.

theorem.name: Rule.loose_content_mix
theorem.description: If RF may change norms, it has verdict mix for the content basis, given two distinct norms.

theorem.name: Rule.loose_structure_brk
theorem.description: Loose RF has verdict brk for the structure basis.

theorem.name: Rule.strict_separates
theorem.description: A domain containing the strict refinement step separates the content and structure bases.

theorem.name: Fork.locus_neu_of_colocated
theorem.description: Under the colocated warrant, BF has verdict neu for the locus basis.

theorem.name: Fork.object_brk_of_fresh
theorem.description: Under the fresh-object warrant, BF has verdict brk for the object basis.

theorem.name: Fork.object_neu_of_same
theorem.description: Under the same-object warrant, BF has verdict neu for the object basis.

theorem.name: Fork.locus_mix_without_warrant
theorem.description: Without a warrant, BF has verdict mix for the locus basis, given two distinct loci and two distinct branches.

theorem.name: Fork.object_mix_without_warrant
theorem.description: Without a warrant, BF has verdict mix for the object basis, given two distinct objects and two distinct branches.

theorem.name: Fork.separates_under_warrants
theorem.description: Under the colocated and fresh-object warrants, a domain containing the fork separates the locus and object bases.

theorem.name: Fork.collapses_under_same_object
theorem.description: Under the colocated and same-object warrants, the locus and object bases collapse on every domain.

theorem.name: ScopeEntries.strict_structure_brk

theorem.name: ScopeEntries.loose_extension_mix

theorem.name: ScopeEntries.loose_structure_brk
theorem.description: With one field per pair of cases, loose AD has verdict brk for the structure basis.

theorem.name: ScopeEntries.extensionBasis_minimal
theorem.description: The support of the extension basis is justified: every diagonal pair can change coverage on its own.

theorem.name: ScopeEntries.structureBasis_minimal
theorem.description: The support of the structure basis is justified: every pair can change the organization on its own.

theorem.name: RuleEntries.structureBasis_minimal

theorem.name: RuleEntries.contentBasis_minimal

theorem.name: RuleEntries.strict_content_neu

theorem.name: RuleEntries.strict_structure_brk

theorem.name: RuleEntries.loose_content_mix
theorem.description: With one field per dependency, loose RF has verdict mix for the content basis, given two distinct norms.

theorem.name: RuleEntries.loose_structure_brk
theorem.description: With one field per dependency, loose RF has verdict brk for the structure basis.
